categories.main_business_segments: The company specializes in the research, design, and sales of high-performance analog integrated circuit chips, primarily divided into signal chain analog chips and power management analog chips. These products are widely applied in smartphones, computers, automotive electronics, servers, smart wearables, smart home appliances, communication equipment, robotics, and security fields.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced BCD (Bipolar-CMOS-DMOS) process technology, including 12-inch wafer production and 90nm nodes, with proprietary innovations such as ultra-low parasitic capacitance ESD structures, high-voltage MOS devices, and high-precision operational amplifiers. It follows a fabless model, outsourcing wafer manufacturing and packaging/testing to leading foundries and partners while focusing on chip design and R&D.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading smartphone manufacturers (OPPO, Xiaomi, Vivo, Samsung), automotive electronics companies, server and data center providers, AI device makers, robotics firms, and industrial control sectors. The company serves both domestic and international markets with a focus on high-growth sectors like AI, automotive electronics, and consumer electronics.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters in Jiangsu and offices in Shanghai. It has wholly-owned subsidiaries in Hong Kong, the United States, Taiwan, South Korea, and Singapore, supporting global sales and technical services. Its products are sold domestically and internationally, with significant revenue from both domestic and overseas markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates as a fabless semiconductor design firm, focusing on chip design and sales while outsourcing wafer fabrication and packaging/testing to upstream foundries and subcontractors. It maintains close, long-term partnerships with key suppliers to ensure quality and supply chain efficiency.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include continuous R&D investment to expand product lines, enhance chip performance, and develop differentiated, cost-effective analog chips. The company emphasizes innovation in AI-related applications, automotive electronics, high-speed signal transmission, and power management. It also focuses on upgrading manufacturing processes, developing proprietary IP, and expanding into new markets like robotics and servers.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of analog integrated circuits, including signal chain and power management chips. The company mainly uses a buyout distribution model with distributors and also engages in direct sales to key customers. Revenue recognition occurs upon customer receipt of goods, following standard sales contracts.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes in the analog semiconductor market dominated globally by firms like Texas Instruments, Analog Devices, Infineon, and STMicroelectronics. While international giants hold significant market share, the company positions itself as a leading domestic analog chip supplier with a growing product portfolio and increasing market penetration, especially in China’s expanding semiconductor market.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved revenue of approximately RMB 526 million, a 38% increase year-over-year, driven by expanded market share and new product sales. However, it reported a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 47 million, impacted by increased R&D and sales expenses. The company’s total assets were around RMB 2.9 billion, with a strong focus on R&D investment accounting for nearly 40% of revenue.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-performance, low-power, and high-reliability analog chips with advanced process technologies and proprietary IP. Its products offer superior signal integrity, high bandwidth, and robust protection features tailored for demanding applications in AI, automotive, and consumer electronics. The company’s full product line and strong customer service enable rapid market response and comprehensive solutions, supporting domestic substitution of imported chips.
